label: timing chain stretch and tensioner failure
symptom: Rattling noise at cold start, especially around 200,000 km, with potential for catastrophic engine failure if chain jumps timing.
cause: Timing chain stretch and tensioner wear, allowing excessive slack; camshaft adjuster seals can leak oil, causing erratic timing adjustment.
fix: Replace timing chain, tensioner, guides, and camshaft adjuster seals; check tensioner extension (if >5 rings visible, replace chain system).
